forum.error_locked: Editing dice is disabled here. Keep the original count, ranges and order.
forum.error_too_many: A post may contain at most {count} dice.
forum.error_invalid_ledger: The saved dice record could not be read. Please contact an administrator.

admin.intro: Use [minimum, maximum] for an inclusive integer die. Previews stay pending; new results appear after posting or saving an edit.
admin.lifecycle: Old posts are never rolled automatically. With editing enabled, new dice in a manual edit are rolled. Hiding preserves results; permanent deletion removes them. Disabling, removing or uninstalling retains the result column for reinstall.
admin.successHigh: High results mean success (off: low results mean success)
admin.criticalPercent: Percentage of outcomes at each end (%, default 5)
admin.critical_help: After the minimum face count, take a fixed outcome count or a percentage at each end. Percentages use all possible outcomes, round down, and include at least one. Each end is capped at half the faces. Switching modes retains both values; results never change.
admin.signEnabled: Color positive / negative / zero when the range crosses zero
admin.sequenceEnabled: Highlight ascending / descending consecutive digits (123, 321; no wrap)
admin.numbers_help: Comma-separated integers; up to 100 entries. Leave empty for none.
admin.priority_help: Include each once: special, repeat, sequence, success, failure, positive, negative, zero. The first match controls the colors and tooltip label.
admin.colors_help: Use hexadecimal colors, optionally with alpha. Empty text/background inherit normal dice colors; empty icon follows text. Settings never change stored results.
admin.allowEdit: Allow editing, adding and removing dice (default on)
admin.editing_help: Identical ranges reuse results in occurrence order; unmatched dice are rolled and removed results are discarded. A changed sequence marks all remaining dice as edited, including possible selection by deletion. Prose-only edits do not add a mark.
admin.criticalCount: Number of outcomes at each end (default 1)
admin.labels_help: Leave empty for the current language default; up to 40 characters. Only the highest priority matching effect appears in the tooltip.
admin.icons_help: Generic and edited dice accept Font Awesome classes. Enable each standard die separately and select built-in artwork, Font Awesome or a regular image. Use a root-relative or HTTP(S) image URL; images keep their original colors. Masks and font icons follow the palette. Missing default regular glyphs fall back to solid.
admin.markEdited: Use a different icon for edited dice (default on)
admin.icon_enabled: Use a special icon for this die
